summary: Evaluate forecasts, regression and classification outputs using CRISP-DM and Excel. Develop decision-ready analysis in this five-day foundation course.
lede: Predictive data analytics helps analysts and operational planners assess forecasts from historical data before using them in planning. For foundation-level learners who use spreadsheets, this non-programming course covers framing prediction questions with CRISP-DM, checking data, and building baseline forecasts and introductory regression in Excel. You’ll compare results with MAE and RMSE, assess classification outputs, and communicate assumptions, errors, and limitations in decision briefs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare or use forecasts, estimates and predictive indicators in operational planning. It suits foundation-level learners who can work with spreadsheets and want a structured, non-programming approach to evaluating predictions.
audience: Maintenance Planners using asset histories to prioritize
Monitoring and Evaluation Officers using historical indicators
prerequisites: Basic spreadsheet literacy, including entering data and using simple formulas. No programming experience is required.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
